title: Noel 2018 · sound velocity and face/trunk PPS
citation: Noel, J. P., Blanke, O., Magosso, E., & Serino, A. (2018). Neural adaptation accounts for the dynamic resizing of peripersonal space: evidence from a psychophysical-computational approach. Journal of Neurophysiology, 119(6), 2307–2333.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

cohort.assignment: Forehead versus sternum is between participants. Both velocities occur within each cohort.

published_method.geometry: Two parallel eight-speaker rows run 2 m toward the body; each is 50 cm out to the side. Adapt the rows to forehead or sternum height. Present broadband noise at the reported 50 dB.

grid.anchor: Sound onset, or matched silent-trial onset

schedule.order: Randomly intermix speeds and trial families within a participant.

published_method.tactile: Drive a Precision MicroDrives 312-101 motor at the assigned body site for 100 ms. Motor timing differs from the software trigger.
published_method.response: Speeded button press for touch. Withhold to sound alone.
published_method.analysis: Within a participant and speed, subtract the shorter median of the two silent baselines. Fit the corrected delay/distance response separately for each speed and cohort after the published reaction-time exclusions.

source_provenance.value: New article delegates sound movement algorithm to Serino et al. (2015b).
source_provenance.gap: Original 2018 sound files or renderer code were not identified.

value.direction: looming from in front toward the body

stimulus_duration.gap: Nominal transit time from 2 m divided by the reported speed. Exact rendered sample duration and pre/post-sound buffers were not reported.

gain_envelope.value: Constant reported loudness of 50 dB. Cited renderer changes channel levels with distance.
gain_envelope.gap: 2018 calibration reference, ramp/gate and exact per-channel gains unspecified. The predecessor has an equation/prose attenuation discrepancy.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two arrays of eight JBL Control 1 Pro WH Pair speakers each, M-Audio FastTrack Ultra 8R. Arrays 50 cm to either side and extend 2 m ahead at face or sternum height.
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Speaker weighting parameters and exact 2018 renderer configuration unresolved.

value: Tactile-only baseline at D1 or D7 temporal equivalent

condition_intermixing.value: Slow and Fast across trial types within participant. Body part is between participants.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Number of blocks, allocation per block, randomization algorithm and seed unspecified.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: No ITI, foreperiod distribution, or separate jitter rule identified.

response_window.gap: Online deadline unspecified. Analysis excludes RTs below 200 ms or above 900 ms.

task_sequence_rules.value: Sound starts at trial onset for audio-bearing trials. On tactile vibration, press the controller button quickly and accurately, ignoring the sound. Withhold response on catches.

tactile_stimulus.gap: Reported motor ratings do not establish measured acceleration, onset latency or individual calibration.

value.note: Times retain the precision reported in the Methods.

baseline_strategy.value: Silent tactile trials at the two endpoint sampling times D7 and D1, matched separately to each nominal speed. Faster baseline median is used for that participant and speed.

value.anchor: trial onset corresponding to the sound onset in matched bimodal trials

baseline_timing.gap: Select T1 and T7 from each reported schedule. No sound plays in the baseline trials.

catch_trial_type.value: Looming sound with no tactile target. Withhold response.

block_count.gap: The procedure reports overall trial randomization and total, with no block count.

implementation_gaps: Implement and calibrate two physical eight-speaker arrays at the assigned cohort height, using the original per-channel gains and measured acoustic onset. The sound spectrum, waveform and delivered level calibration are not recoverable from the paper.
The runtime must keep the correct offset table and silent-baseline windows tied to each speed. A global SOA product across both speeds changes the reported schedule.
The rotating 312-101 motor requires calibration of delivered acceleration and timing at the study's forehead or sternum location. Original randomization and intertrial allocation are unavailable.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
